title: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2

entities.name: Cecilee
entities.description: Ruzi's sister, once a mute elf girl who became a voice of the Worldsoul, who founds a Selesnya settlement in the Rubblebelt and is killed by Massacre Girl.

entities.name: Ruzi
entities.description: Cecilee's older brother, a skilled fighter who protected her in childhood and counseled her against going to the Rubblebelt.

entities.name: Zi
entities.description: An infant Gruul child, found abandoned in the Rubblebelt and named after Ruzi, whom Cecilee adopts as her son.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: A starved, painted-smile Rakdos killer for hire who massacres Cecilee's followers and cuts her throat.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: The Selesnya guildmaster whose recitation Cecilee interrupted when she first spoke.

entities.name: Nikya
entities.description: A Gruul leader who claims the adopted boy as kin and demands he be raised Gruul.

entities.name: Rakdos Cult
entities.description: The guild of killers to which Massacre Girl belongs.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: A collection of savage clans of the Rubblebelt who grow angry with Cecilee and demand the child back.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The guild of harmony whose followers Cecilee leads to the Rubblebelt.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The guild whose arrestor imposes fines on Cecilee's settlement and cites statutes against her healing center.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: A guild whose mage demanded that Cecilee's community leave over arcane energy and portals.

entities.name: Worldsoul
entities.description: The collective unconsciousness that Cecilee channels.

entities.name: Guild tree
entities.description: A young sapling of the guildtree in the settlement's courtyard, which Massacre Girl rips from the ground.

entities.name: Cecilee's vernadi
entities.description: Cecilee's walled Selesnya community in the Rubblebelt with a healing center.

entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: The ruined region of Ravnica that is home to the Gruul.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The Selesnya seat where Cecilee grew up and first spoke.

events.summary: Cecilee, mute from childhood, suddenly speaks in a beautiful recitation in praise of Selesnya at Vitu-Ghazi, and the dryads call her a conduit to the Worldsoul.
events.quote: And then one day Cecilee did speak.

events.summary: Feeling called to establish a settlement in the Rubblebelt, Cecilee ignores Ruzi's warnings and leads twenty followers there.
events.quote: And so she went, leading twenty followers, to the wildest place any of them could imagine.

events.summary: Cecilee adopts an abandoned infant with a Gruul tattoo and names him Ruzi, calling him Zi.
events.quote: Cecilee named the child after her brother, Ruzi, and took him into her home to raise as her own son.

events.summary: A Gruul shaman from Nikya's clan comes to take Zi back, but Cecilee refuses, and the Gruul begin attacking the Selesnyans.
events.quote: After Cecilee adopted Zi, the Gruul sent a woman to take him back.

events.summary: Before sunrise, an ogre breaks through the gate followed by Massacre Girl and her men, who are not Gruul.
events.quote: Just before sunrise, their gate flew off the hinges and splintered on the ground.

events.summary: Massacre Girl strikes Cecilee and tears the young guild tree from the ground.
events.quote: The woman ripped the young guild tree out of the ground and hurled it across the courtyard

events.summary: Massacre Girl cuts off Cecilee's hair while Cecilee freezes.
events.quote: The woman took out her rusty blade and chopped the blonde hair from Cecilee's head.

events.summary: Cecilee's followers lie dead, and Cecilee, mute again and cut off from the Worldsoul, has her throat cut.
events.quote: There was just the woman and her rusty blade cutting Cecilee's throat

relations.quote: Cecilee named the child after her brother, Ruzi

relations.note: She adopts him as her own son.
relations.quote: took him into her home to raise as her own son.
There was just the woman and her rusty blade cutting Cecilee's throat

relations.note: She is a for-hire Rakdos killer.
relations.quote: She didn't know the woman was a for-hire Rakdos killer who called herself Massacre Girl.
She explained that Nikya claimed the boy as kin and demanded he be raised as Gruul.

relations.note: She is a Selesnyan under the guildmaster.
relations.quote: just as the Guildmaster Trostani was finished with her recitation.
